verdict.rationale: Docs claim you can 'configure, deploy and monitor' agents and offer post-call analytics (sentiment analysis, success evaluation, data extraction, conversation search), but there is no evidence of live-call monitoring dashboards, error-rate tracking, or alerting/notification mechanisms for misbehaving agents in production.  Missing for 10: real-time monitoring dashboard, error-rate/anomaly alerting, notification/webhook triggers for spikes, independent confirmation of production monitoring workflow.
